lead_updates.shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Firenze, Mediceo avanti il Principato, filza LXXII, docs. 307, 309, 310, 311, 322, 333
lead_updates.title: Francesco Pandolfini, Florentine orator in France, Oct 1514 - Mar 1515: six cipher letters and copies with no decipherment found, beside about fifteen cipher/decipherment pairs of the same system in MAP LXXII
lead_updates.folio_note: 307 (c. 369, copy to the Otto di Pratica of 16 Feb 1514 st. fior., with a clear note to Lorenzo of 16 Feb): about 25 cipher lines; 309 (cc. 378/383, to Lorenzo in Rome, Paris 26 Feb 1514 st. fior.): about 10 lines; 310 (cc. 380-381, copy to the Otto, 25 Feb - 2 Mar): about 70 lines; 311 (cc. 382/379, continuation to the Otto, "Tenuta a di iiij"): nearly two sides; 322 (c. 401, "Copia di 2 cap. scripti ad Roma sotto di 20 d'ottobre" 1514): two blocks of 7 and one of 2 lines; 333 (cc. 417/427, to Lorenzo in Rome, Paris 27 Dec 1514): 3 lines. 297 (copy to the Otto, 22 Jan 1514 st. fior.) was dropped from this lead: its decipherment is very probably LXXII 368 (see vetting).

seen.extent: Six pieces, about 120 cipher lines in all (310 and 311 the bulk), between clear passages.
seen.cipher: Latin letters and digits with superscript figures 1-5 (e.g. 307 "or w y we r w g 7 φ q r 4 y S F S x φ 7 t ...", 333 "3 4 φ 2 y 3 3 5 3 c L ..."), with dotted numeral groups ("3.20.", "3.c.2."). No gloss on any of the six. Filed clear texts checked by heading and date: 284 copy of 2 Jan 1515; 306 copy of 28 Jan; 313 copy of 20 Feb (clear text of 308); 316 paired with 315; 332 copy of 27 Dec 1514 to the Otto = decipherment of 334 (the Otto letter), not of 333's covering-note lines; 337 copy of 2x Mar 1515; 344 and 350 copies of Apr and later 1515; 365 extract "tratte di cifra" of 2x Mar 1515; 366 extract of 6 Oct 1514 (Abbeville) and "Copia de capitoli scripti a Roma tratti di cifra" (c. 469, about 45 lines on the Milan enterprise, far longer than 322 and with none of 322's clear frame: archdeacon, Rocciafort, Alfonso Ariosti); 368 "Decifrato" of letters of the 21st to Lorenzo and the 22nd to the Otto; 419 copy of 6 Dec 1514. None deciphers 307, 309, 310, 311, 322 or 333. 368 matches 297 (to the Otto, 22 Jan 1515: 309 and 310 show Pandolfini wrote to Lorenzo on 20 Feb and to the Otto on 20 and 25 Feb, so the 21st/22nd must be January; 297 has about 280 cipher signs for 368's second text of about 600 letters, roughly the ratio of the cipher in 334 to the clear text in 332), so 297 is taken out of the lead.
